item.title: SalesPatriot (YC W25) Is Hiring Forward Deployed Engineers
item.description:
📝 AI powered operating system for distributors and OEMs America's industrial base runs on systems built in the 1980s. Billions of dollars in critical components (F-35 parts, industrial assemblies, electronics, bolts, and hoses) still move through email threads, excel sheets, and disconnected ERPs. We're replacing that with an AI-native platform that makes aerospace, electronics, industrial, and defense supply-chain operations nearly autonomous.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/salespatriot/jobs/M46X6YX-forward-deployed-engineer

item.title: Tumble Forth – from assembly to OS with C compiler
item.description:
📝 I intend do to that through story arcs leading, step by step, to some nice and shiny objective. If you're the target reader but find some parts of this content difficult to understand, this is not intentional. Starting from bare metal on the PC platform, we build a Forth from scratch, then switch to Dusk OS and then build a partial C compiler (just enough to compile our example code), again from scratch.
🔗 Read more: https://tumbleforth.hardcoded.net/

item.title: The B-right/V R2 Operating System (2000)
item.description:
📝 " The network interface computer differs from the standard personal computers of today mainly in terms of size. BTRON lies between today's gargantuan personal computer operating systems--which have become as large as mainframe computer operating systems and continue to get bigger with each new upgrade. --and the stripped down operating systems of LAN-based network computers.
🔗 Read more: http://tronweb.super-nova.co.jp/b-right-vr2intro.html
